name: Becker County, MN
findings: Becker County has 133 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Becker County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Economic development organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 5 economic development organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
